differs_from_hero: revised quote Q-1187-B keeps an arrival commitment: 'delivered to your address by 9 November' (only the quote number and validity change)

expected.words: A quote's own delivery date counts as verified arrival. Rannavere still commits to delivery by Nov 9, so a verified on-time route survives past 07:00 and nothing is lost by waiting.

title: Evidence: revision keeping arrival date must not wake
